text.p: Lindeteves-Jacoberg Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed with Chinese state-owned Dalian Electric Motor Works to set up a joint venture in Dalian, China to make electric motors and related products and accessories.

The company said in a statement the total registered capital of the venture, to be called Western Electric (Dalian) Motor Co Ltd, would be 100 million yuan. Lindeteves-Jacoberg would contribute 50 percent of this capital in cash.
Its Chinese partner would contribute its 50 percent of the capital in the form of land use rights to be transfered to the joint venture. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703199)
